mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CS VALUES(SEQ_CS_NO.NEXTVAL, #{csWriterName}, #{csWriterEmail}, #{csContent}, DEFAULT, DEFAULT)
mapper.select: SELECT CS_NO, CS_WRITER_NAME, CS_WRITER_EMAIL, CS_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(CS_WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일"') CS_WRITE_DATE, CS_COMPLETE_YN FROM CS ORDER BY CS_COMPLETE_YN, CS_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE CS SET CS_COMPLETE_YN = 'Y' WHERE CS_NO = #{csNo}
